title: 05 discard, https://use05.dev/discard/v0
description: An in-toto Statement v1 carrying a person's word to throw a task's work away. Subject: the work (task, and gitCommit, the branch's head). Acted on where the work is; never stored as a receipt. Fields are only ever added, as optional ones.

branch.description: The task's own branch, when it has one 05 may delete.

head.description: That branch's head when the discard was prepared: if it moves, the discard does not apply.

unpushed.description: Commits on no remote branch and not landed.

uncommitted.description: Files in its worktree that were never committed.
